evidence.reason: The triage judge path checks runner_disabled and the GLM blackout, but not dispatch_paused; drain's pause check at line 815 only guards drain entry. A --triage-dry-run path can therefore reach phase/judge and dispatch at line 785 while the global provider rate-limit marker is active. The current contract requires respecting the rate-limit cooldown, and returning a deferred judge result is the smallest compatible fix.
